due_when.clears_when: get_positions() resolves category from the account's actual market_type (matching _bybit_category() in src/units/accounts/execute.py) instead of hardcoding "spot", and a test asserts the category passed to fetch_positions.

what: AUD-20260927-CA-A15-bybit-positions-spot-category: src/exchange/bybit_connector.py:98 BybitConnector.get_positions() calls self.exchange.fetch_positions(params={"category": "spot"}) unconditionally, even for linear-perpetual accounts (e.g. bybit_2), so it silently returns [] instead of the real open-position list. Consumed by src/runtime/risk_counters.py::inject_runtime_counters to populate CURRENT_OPEN_POSITIONS, which gates MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS in src/runtime/orders.py::safe_place_order. Currently dormant because MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS is not set in any config/env file (grep -rn MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS config/ *.env* *.service -> no hits), so the guard is a no-op today regardless of this bug -- but the method is broken unconditionally and would silently defeat the guard the moment anyone sets MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS.
